en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a dam and several residential buildings, most likely associated with industrial or administrative use, amid a rural, forested landscape. The text on the image reads 'Alby. Dammen och Disponentbostäderna.', indicating the location and the type of buildings shown. The reverse side includes handwritten script, postage information in Swedish, and an address to a recipient, 'Herr Isak Kindström, Hussborgs J.Stn., Johanneberg.' There is also a stamp of 'Svenska Litografiska AB Stockholm' and old Swedish postage rates.
